description: a > b > c > a (parentId runs a to c, c to b, b to a). The cycle is reported once, starting at its smallest id and closing on it, and the self-parent d is a cycle of its own. Levels are all type; a type below a type is legal (the tree keeps its source depth), so the cycles are the only errors.
